Robe panels are more closed than the official three-quarter portrait and remain rigid in the body layer. Most visible walk motion will be the lower boots; this is not a claim of full natural gait acceptance.
Full-leg upper thighs are an ivory-covered inference because the official portrait conceals that anatomy.
Rear embroidery, feather arrangement and quiver placement are inferred from a single frontal portrait; this minor uncertainty does not alone hold the candidate.
Face and ornamental details are regenerated interpretations of the official male identity.
Body pivots and fixed standing references are anatomical estimates, not atlas height or changing frame bounds. All pieces remain source scale1; assembled calibration remains provisional.
Highly saturated red/yellow fringe visible in the image preview has only alpha1-3. No such pixels have alpha>16. PNGs remain unchanged; alpha>16 component outlines exclude external faint fringe.
Head/bow margins are narrow, but no alpha>16 pixels touch any outer canvas edge.
LEFT is the authorized RIGHT mirror; this reverses the original weapon hand and asymmetrical outfit.
down.coordinateSystem: Whole assembly waist origin; anchor denotes projected neutral ground, not atlas pixels.
